history_requirement.static: Causal accumulated evidence is sufficient; strict order is not required.
history_requirement.dynamic: Ordered causal history and relative poses are required.

invalid_target_policy: Use explicit masks; unavailable labels are not converted to zero.

history_contract.history_time_deltas: negative seconds relative to current; v4 inherited approximate deltas from trajectory median spacing
history_contract.relative_pose_alignment: row t corresponds to history frame t
